title: Tumor-Homing CAR T Cells Armored with an Inducible IL-12 Switch
description: Solid tumors suppress CAR T cells, and systemic IL-12 is too toxic to give patients. This CAR T platform releases IL-12 only inside the tumor through a drug-inducible genetic switch. Stage: preclinical; the armored cells cleared ovarian and pancreatic tumors in two mouse models without weight loss or cytokine storm.
advantages: Local IL-12 release avoids systemic toxicity.
Works with any CAR target antigen.
Switch is controlled by an approved oral drug.

looking_for: Exclusive license or a startup partner to fund IND-enabling studies.

title: Bispecific Antibody Blocking PD-1 and the Myeloid Checkpoint MCR-7
description: Most patients do not respond to PD-1 blockade because suppressive myeloid cells remain active. This bispecific antibody blocks PD-1 and MCR-7, a myeloid checkpoint discovered at Dartmouth, in one molecule. Stage: IND-enabling; the lead candidate doubled survival in PD-1-resistant mouse melanoma and is stable at clinical concentrations.
advantages: Lead candidate and backup sequences available.
Manufacturable in standard CHO cell lines.

looking_for: Exclusive worldwide license; open to co-development with an oncology company.

title: mRNA Neoantigen Vaccine Design Pipeline for Pancreatic Cancer
description: Pancreatic tumors carry few targetable mutations. This pipeline ranks patient neoantigens with a validated algorithm and encodes the top 20 in a single mRNA vaccine. Stage: early preclinical; vaccines designed by the pipeline expanded tumor-specific T cells in mice, and no human data exist yet.
advantages: Personalized design in under two weeks.

looking_for: Sponsored research or an option to license.

title: Oncolytic Herpes Virus Engineered to Express a STING Agonist
description: Cold tumors are invisible to the immune system. This oncolytic herpes virus kills tumor cells and produces a STING agonist that turns cold tumors hot. Stage: clinical-ready; GMP virus lots exist and an investigator-led Phase 1 trial in melanoma is planned for 2027.
advantages: Combines direct tumor killing with innate immune activation.
Synergy with PD-1 antibodies shown in mice.

looking_for: Exclusive license to a company able to run Phase 1 and Phase 2 trials.

title: Small-Molecule Inhibitor of the Immunosuppressive Enzyme ARG-2
description: Tumors use the enzyme ARG-2 to starve T cells of arginine. This program has selective small-molecule ARG-2 inhibitors. Stage: hit-to-lead; three chemical series inhibit ARG-2 in cell assays, and no animal efficacy data exist yet.
advantages: Selective over the related enzyme ARG-1.

looking_for: Research collaboration with a medicinal chemistry partner.

title: Liquid Biopsy Assay Detecting Minimal Residual Disease in Colorectal Cancer
description: After surgery, doctors cannot tell which colorectal cancer patients still carry tumor cells. This blood test detects tumor DNA at one part per million. Stage: clinical validation; the assay predicted relapse in a 210-patient retrospective study.
advantages: Ten times more sensitive than current assays.

looking_for: Non-exclusive licenses to diagnostic laboratories.

title: Radiation-Activated Nanoparticles for Glioblastoma
description: Glioblastoma recurs after radiation therapy. These gold-hafnium nanoparticles cross the blood-brain barrier and amplify the radiation dose inside the tumor. Stage: preclinical; the particles extended survival by 60 percent in rat glioma models.
advantages: Particles clear from the body within 30 days.

looking_for: Exclusive license or startup formation.

title: Antibody-Drug Conjugate Targeting Ovarian Cancer Stem Cells
description: Ovarian cancer often returns because chemotherapy spares cancer stem cells. This antibody-drug conjugate targets a stem cell surface marker and delivers a potent payload. Stage: preclinical; it eliminated stem cells in patient-derived tumor models.
advantages: Targets the cells that drive relapse.
Uses a clinically validated payload and linker.

looking_for: Exclusive license.

title: Gut Microbiome Consortium to Boost Checkpoint Inhibitor Response
description: Patients whose gut bacteria lack certain strains respond poorly to checkpoint inhibitors. This defined consortium of eight bacterial strains restores response. Stage: preclinical; the consortium turned non-responder mice into responders.
advantages: Defined strains instead of fecal transplant.

looking_for: Option to license with sponsored research.

title: Reversing T-Cell Exhaustion with a TOX Degrader
description: Exhausted T cells stop attacking tumors. This early discovery program degrades TOX, a master regulator of exhaustion, to restore T cell function. Stage: discovery; degrader compounds work in human T cells in a dish.
advantages: Addresses a root cause of immunotherapy failure.

looking_for: Discovery partnership; the lab has an extensive IP portfolio under development.

title: Biologic Targeting IL-17F for Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Many rheumatoid arthritis patients stop responding to TNF blockers. This antibody blocks IL-17F selectively to control joint inflammation. Stage: preclinical; it reduced joint swelling in two arthritis models.

looking_for: Exclusive license to an immunology company.

title: Solid-State Sodium Battery with a Sulfide Electrolyte
description: Lithium is costly and supply-constrained. This solid-state sodium battery uses a sulfide electrolyte that conducts ions at room temperature. Stage: lab prototype; pouch cells kept 90 percent capacity after 500 cycles.

looking_for: Exclusive license or startup formation with a battery manufacturer.

title: Self-Healing Polymer Binder for Silicon Anodes
description: Silicon anodes store ten times more lithium than graphite but crack as they swell. This self-healing polymer binder repairs the cracks during cycling. Stage: lab validation; coin cells with the binder lasted three times longer than commercial binders.
advantages: Drop-in replacement in existing electrode lines.

looking_for: Non-exclusive or field-of-use licenses.

title: Low-Cost Perovskite Tandem Solar Coating
description: Silicon solar panels are near their efficiency limit. This perovskite coating is printed on top of silicon cells to form a tandem cell. Stage: lab prototype; 1 square centimeter tandem cells reached 29 percent efficiency, and long-term stability is still being tested.

looking_for: Joint development with a solar module maker.

title: Wireless Methane Leak Sensor Network for Gas Wells
description: Methane leaks from gas wells go undetected for weeks. This network of solar-powered sensors detects leaks within minutes and locates them. Stage: field pilot; 40 sensors ran for a year at two well pads in Pennsylvania.
advantages: Detects leaks of 1 kilogram per hour.

looking_for: Exclusive license or startup formation.

title: Direct Air Capture Sorbent Made from Mining Waste
description: Direct air capture sorbents are expensive. This sorbent is made from mine tailings and captures carbon dioxide from air at room temperature. Stage: bench scale; one kilogram batches captured 1.2 millimoles of CO2 per gram.

looking_for: Sponsored research toward a pilot.

title: Thermal Battery for Industrial Heat Using Molten-Salt Bricks
description: Factories burn natural gas for process heat. This thermal battery stores cheap renewable electricity as heat in molten-salt bricks and releases steam on demand. Stage: prototype; a 100 kilowatt-hour unit delivered steam at 400 degrees Celsius.
advantages: Delivers steam for 12 hours per charge.

looking_for: Licensing or startup formation.

title: Flow Battery Membrane from Recycled Plastics
description: Membranes are the most expensive part of grid-scale flow batteries. This membrane is made from recycled PET bottles and matches the conductivity of commercial membranes. Stage: lab validation; test cells ran 1,000 cycles.
advantages: Costs a tenth of commercial membranes.

looking_for: Exclusive license.

title: AI Forecasting Software for Wind Farm Output
description: Grid operators curtail wind power because output is hard to predict. This software forecasts wind farm output 48 hours ahead from weather data. Stage: pilot; forecasts were 18 percent more accurate than a commercial service at one New England wind farm.

looking_for: Software license.

title: Corrosion-Resistant Coating for Offshore Wind Turbines
description: Salt spray corrodes offshore wind turbines and drives up maintenance costs. This ceramic-polymer coating resists corrosion for twice as long as current coatings. Stage: field test; coated panels have been exposed on a North Sea platform for 18 months.

looking_for: Non-exclusive licenses to coating manufacturers.

title: Platinum-Free Catalyst for Hydrogen Electrolyzers
description: Electrolyzers that make green hydrogen depend on scarce platinum and iridium. This nickel-molybdenum catalyst matches platinum performance in alkaline electrolyzers. Stage: bench; the catalyst ran 2,000 hours without losing activity.
advantages: Made by a simple electrodeposition process.

looking_for: Exclusive license or joint development with an electrolyzer company.

title: Adaptive Math Tutoring App for Middle Schools
description: Middle school students fall behind in math and teachers cannot personalize practice for every student. This app adapts problem difficulty to each student in real time. Stage: deployed; used by 1,200 students in three New Hampshire school districts.

looking_for: Software license to an education company.

title: Screening Method for Drought-Tolerant Maple Trees
description: Drought is killing sugar maples across New England. This genetic screening method identifies drought-tolerant seedlings in two weeks instead of five years. Stage: validated in greenhouse trials.
advantages: Uses a low-cost leaf sample test.

looking_for: Licensing to tree nurseries.

title: Low-Cost Dental Cavity Imaging Device
description: Dental X-rays miss early cavities and expose patients to radiation. This handheld near-infrared camera images early cavities without radiation. Stage: clinical study; it detected early cavities in 150 patients with 94 percent accuracy.

looking_for: Exclusive license to a dental device company.

title: Wearable Gait Sensor for Parkinson's Fall Risk
description: Falls are a leading cause of hospitalization in Parkinson's disease. This shoe-insole sensor predicts fall risk from walking patterns. Stage: clinical pilot with 60 patients.

looking_for: License to a digital health company.

title: Handwriting Recognition for Archival Documents
description: Libraries hold millions of handwritten pages that cannot be searched. This software reads 18th- and 19th-century handwriting. Stage: deployed at the Dartmouth library on 40,000 pages.
advantages: 95 percent character accuracy on historical scripts.

looking_for: Software license.

title: Biodegradable High-Performance Ski Wax
description: Fluorinated ski waxes are now banned because they persist in the environment. This plant-based wax matches their glide performance and biodegrades. Stage: tested by the Dartmouth ski team for one season.

looking_for: License to a winter sports brand.

title: Snow Load Monitoring System for Flat Roofs
description: Heavy snow collapses flat roofs on warehouses and schools. This system of wireless load sensors warns building managers before snow load becomes dangerous. Stage: installed on six buildings in Vermont.

looking_for: Exclusive license.

title: Vaccine Adjuvant for Poultry
description: Avian influenza outbreaks force farms to cull millions of birds. This adjuvant makes poultry vaccines effective with a single dose. Stage: field trial on two commercial farms.
advantages: Stable without refrigeration for one week.

looking_for: License to an animal health company.

title: Noise-Reducing Smart Alarm System for Hospitals
description: Hospital alarm fatigue causes staff to miss critical alerts. This system routes alarms to the right nurse's wearable and silences non-critical ones. Stage: pilot on one intensive care unit.
advantages: Cut alarm noise by 70 percent in the pilot.

looking_for: Software and hardware license.
